name: Roc Hatchling
narration: "A young roc, still downy about the neck, mistook the ship's mast for its mother's eyrie," said Shahrazad, "and did not take kindly to correction."

name: Drowned Sailor
narration: "Ya Allah [O God]," breathed Shahrazad, "a sailor long lost to the deep rose dripping from the shallows, his eyes gone the color of the tide."

name: Storm Sprite
narration: "A sprite spun down out of a clear sky," said Shahrazad, "crackling with a storm that hadn't been forecast to anyone but itself."

name: Cyclopean Shepherd's Ram
narration: "The shepherd was one-eyed and enormous, but it was his ram that came first," said Shahrazad, "horns lowered, unimpressed by any story it hadn't already heard."

name: Living Figurehead
narration: "Astaghfirullah [I seek God's forgiveness]," said Shahrazad, "the carved woman on the derelict's prow opened her wooden eyes and tore herself free of the hull."

name: Merchant of Dubious Meat
narration: "A merchant on the shoreline sold skewers of a meat no one could name," said Shahrazad, "and grew violent when Sinbad declined to buy."

name: Cannibal Scout
narration: "A scout crept from the tree line, paint on his face and a hunger in his eyes," said Shahrazad, "of a kind Sinbad did not care to understand."

name: Diamond-Valley Serpent
narration: "Mashallah [what God has willed]," whispered Shahrazad, "a serpent coiled among stones that glittered like a fistful of stars, and guarded them as jealously as its own venom."

name: Siren of the Shoals
narration: "A voice rose from the shoals sweeter than any promise his crew had ever made him," said Shahrazad, "and every man who turned toward it forgot, for a moment, that sirens have claws."

name: Ape of the Black Isle
narration: "Something vast moved among the black rocks of the isle," said Shahrazad, "and when it stood, it stood taller than the mast."

name: The Roc
narration: "Mashallah [what God has willed]," said Shahrazad, "the shadow that fell over the boat was no cloud — it was the Roc itself, mother of hatchlings, wings wide enough to blot out the moon."

name: The Coin Djinn
narration: "Alhamdulillah [praise be to God]," said Shahrazad, "a small djinn shaped like a squirrel scurried up with cheeks full of dinars, offering to hold Sinbad's coin safe — and return it with interest, when the telling was done."

name: Locked Diary
narration: "A diary lay half-buried in the sand, its clasp sealed shut by something more than rust," said Shahrazad, "and whatever secret it kept, it was not ready yet to be told."

name: Eccentric Seeds
narration: "An old woman at the water's edge pressed a handful of strange seeds into Sinbad's palm," said Shahrazad, "and vanished before he could ask what they'd grow into."

name: VIP Card
narration: "A gilded card appeared in Sinbad's pocket, though no hand had put it there," said Shahrazad, "an invitation, it seemed, to somewhere he had not yet been asked."
